thesis: Keep explanation useful by recording alternatives, evidence and revision conditions; act without pretending uncertainty disappeared. The manuscript is argumentative synthesis; explanation debt, laundering, maps, profiles and Outfinitism are exploratory constructs to formalize and test. A compact audit seeks the smallest responsible monitorable reversible step and keeps expertise corrigible.
